blocks.text: Match preview: Kuwait face Qatar in 18th Match, Group B (ODI) on Mon, 7 Sept, 2026, 7:00 am at YSD-UKM Cricket Oval Bangi. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Standard ODI surface expected. Conditions will be clearer at the toss — monitor team selection and dew factor for night games.
Expected par score: 250–290 runs par score.
Light drizzle · High 34°C / Low 25°C · Rain: 0.6 mm · Wind: up to 12 km/h. Light rain possible — overcast conditions could assist swing bowling early.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
